verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one onramp doc line saying Stripe handles regulatory requirements, KYC verifications, and sanctions screening as merchant of record. It names sanctions screening but gives no detail on how it works, and covers only the onramp, not stablecoin payments, payouts, or Treasury. Missing for 10: documented sanctions-screening mechanics, wallet risk/address screening, travel-rule handling, compliance coverage beyond the onramp, independent corroboration.
